summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned bento landing page at '/' (localStorage hasSeenVisitorAuth=true). Tested at 1920, 1536, 768 and 390px with Playwright. All requested flows pass: header nav scrolls to features/use-cases/live-preview/pricing, the Resources dropdown shows 6 items, Sign In and Create Account open the auth modal on the right tab, and the mobile menu opens, scrolls, closes and opens signup. Hero: 4 question chips show the right answers, Create opens signup, Live Demo and Talk to Me scroll to #live-preview. 6 quick-feature tiles, 4 use-case cards, 3 how-steps and 6 feature tiles render. Kousik card shows 'Kousik Kar' / '@kousik', sample stats 847 chats / 1.2K followers / 5.3K views / 940, 'Subscribe - ₹99/mo' and Follow. Posts/Chat/Product tabs switch content, the theme toggle switches dark/light and the demo chat auto-plays. On desktop there are 4 SVG connectors, hovering an indicator highlights it and scales its marker, and indicators don't overlap the card. Pricing from the DB: INR 0/999/1,699/3,999 and USD 0/12/19/49, Pro marked Popular. The currency toggle works, free/creator/pro CTAs open signup and the compare link goes to /pricing. Testimonial next/prev rotate. The final CTA opens signup. The footer has 5 social links. No horizontal scroll at 390, 768 or 1536. No page errors.

issues: Testimonial caption cut off as '— Rahul…'; the role is hidden because the caption is squeezed next to the prev/next buttons in the narrow column
Plan taglines cut off ('Personal Brand B…', 'Professional & C…') at 1536 and 1920

action_items: Optional: let the testimonial name/role wrap (or move prev/next buttons to their own row) so the role isn't cut off
Optional: let pricing taglines wrap to 2 lines (line-clamp-2) instead of cutting them off
critical_code_review_comments: HeroSection.ask: setTimeout isn't cleared on unmount or on quick repeat clicks; an earlier timer can end the typing state early (cosmetic)
SocialProof: the 6s auto-rotate interval isn't reset after manual prev/next, so the slide can change right after a user click
PricingSection 'Live' indicator is always shown; it doesn't reflect the realtime channel's subscription status
Kousik card posts/product tab content has no data-testid wrappers (tested via text)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing v2 components are in frontend/src/components/landing/v2. Default currency at test time was USD. Realtime super-admin price updates were not triggered (no admin rights); only the rendered DB prices were checked. @kousik profile doesn't exist, so sample stats show.
